CAMT · 2026-06-30

Camtek inspection and metrology supports advanced packaging, HBM and interposers. Audited operating EV is USD 1.22bn downcycle, 2.92bn base and 4.89bn upside. These are scenarios without probabilities or stock-price targets.

30 June 2026 capital and discount origin; information through 18 October 2026. July 2026–June 2036 cash flows use later operating disclosures and October discount inputs. This retrospective-information analysis is neither an October cash reconstruction nor an as-known June backtest.

October 14 update: preliminary Q3 USD 160–161m, Q4 about 180m, FY2026 about 595m and initial FY2027 outlook above 800m. YTD orders above 800m cover 2026–27 deliveries and are order intake, not backlog. Base June 2027 sales: 160.50 + 180 + analyst H1 2027 assumption 390 = 730.50m. The roughly three-year USD 1.2bn organic model is a target, expressly not guidance.

Economic margins include fresh equity compensation, expensed R&D and physical depreciation. Fresh grants start at 3.8% of sales and fade to 3.5%. Displayed legacy expense is reversed identically before NOPAT; no duplicate future dilution. Target 34–36% non-GAAP margin is not a GAAP forecast.

Base marginal sales/capital is 1.45×, with down/up 1.25×/1.65×. Base physical capex is 3.3% of sales and depreciation 1.7%; incremental working capital is 35% of positive sales growth plus 3% operating liquidity. No working-capital release is assumed on revenue declines.

Years 1–5 investment is the greater of positive incremental sales / marginal sales-to-capital and the physical, working-capital and operating-cash funding floor. Years 6–10 blend toward NOPAT × terminal growth / ROIC, retaining that floor. Every manual edit and simulation trial recomputes required funding. Entered investment is retained and topped up; an underfunded terminal regime is rejected.

Recurring cash taxes rise from 12% to 23%. The 2025 effective 3.1% tax rate and H1 2026 one-time USD 7.7m tax charge do not establish recurring rates. Interest earned on excess cash is outside operating EBIT.

Base WACC fades from 10.96% to 9.72%. October 16 Treasury yield 5.09%, monthly adjusted ERP 4.20%, US default spread 0.22% and January sector beta 1.39 are mixed-date inputs. Debt weight, spread and mature beta are analyst assumptions.

Terminal growth 2.5% / 3.0% / 3.5% pairs with ROIC 12% / 18% / 22%. Terminal value contributes 51.9% / 60.3% / 66.2% of EV. End-year discounting begins June 30, 2026; every forecast period ends June 30.

June liquid assets USD 815.84m and common outstanding 46.67m are dated observations. The USD 650m convertible placeholder is unmeasured and is not an accepted fair-value claim. Contract settlement may be cash, shares or both; the initial combination default is changeable. No duplicate principal deduction or full conversion-share addition is valid.

Common equity and per-share outputs remain unavailable. June convertible fair value, old-note settlement, gross awards, finance leases and opening tax/acquisition/capital claims remain unresolved. No current quote, price comparison or buyback execution is assumed. Visual Layer was announced April 14 and had closed by May 12; an April closing is not established. Its acquisition is already reflected in June balances and is not charged twice.

New simulation defaults have zero width and are uncalibrated. Monte Carlo runs only on manual request. Named scenarios have no assigned probabilities. Zero-width trials reproduce each selected operating case while equity stays gated.

FY2016–2025 history retains field-level source links and units. 2019–25 diluted-share XBRL scale errors are corrected; 2025 diluted weighted shares are 49.97m, distinct from June common outstanding. Early continuing CFO and potentially total-business capex differ in scope. Reported depreciation discrepancies are retained and flagged.

CAMT · 2026-06-30

Camtek 检测与计量业务服务先进封装、HBM 和中介层。已审核运营企业价值为下行 12.16 亿、基准 29.18 亿、上行 48.87 亿美元；情景没有指定概率，也不是股价目标。

资本及折现基准日为 2026 年 6 月 30 日；信息截至 2026 年 10 月 18 日。2026 年七月至 2036 年六月现金流采用后续经营披露及十月折现参数。这是回溯信息分析，不能视为十月现金重建或六月实时回测。

十月十四日更新：第三季初步收入 160–161 百万美元、第四季约 180、2026 全年约 595、2027 初步展望超过 800。年初至今订单超过 800，交付跨 2026–27 年，是新接订单而非未交付订单余额。至 2027 年六月基准收入为 160.50+180+分析假设 390=730.50 百万美元。约三年 12 亿美元有机收入模型明确属于目标而非指引。

经济利润率含新增股权薪酬、费用化研发及实物折旧。新增授予成本从收入的 3.8% 降至 3.5%。展示的旧奖励费用在 NOPAT 前等额转回，不重复计算未来稀释。34–36% 非 GAAP 利润率是目标，不是 GAAP 预测。

基准边际销售资本比为 1.45 倍，下行及上行为 1.25／1.65 倍。基准实物资本开支占收入 3.3%，折旧 1.7%；增量营运资本占正收入增量 35%，另加 3% 经营现金。收入下降时不假定营运资本释放。

前五年投资取正收入增量除以边际销售资本比与实物资本、营运资本及经营现金资金下限的较大值。第六至十年向 NOPAT×终值增长率／ROIC 过渡，并保留资金下限。每次手动编辑及模拟试验均重算资金需求，保留输入投资并补足缺口；终值资金不足时拒绝计算。

经常性现金税率从 12% 升至 23%。2025 年 3.1% 有效税率和 2026 上半年一次性 7.7 百万美元税费不能代表经常性税率。超额现金利息不计入营业利润。

基准 WACC 从 10.96% 降至 9.72%。十月十六日国债收益率 5.09%、月度调整 ERP 4.20%、美国违约利差 0.22% 及一月行业贝塔 1.39 属于不同日期输入。债务权重、利差及成熟期贝塔为分析假设。

终值增长率 2.5%／3.0%／3.5% 对应 ROIC 12%／18%／22%；终值占企业价值 51.9%／60.3%／66.2%。年末折现始于 2026 年六月三十日，各预测期均截至六月三十日。

六月流动资产 815.84 百万美元及流通普通股 46.67 百万股为历史观察值。650 百万美元可转债占位值未经计量，不是认可的公允价值请求权。合约允许现金、股票或组合结算，初始组合默认方式可更改；不可重复扣除本金或增加全部转换股份。

普通股权益及每股输出仍不可用。六月可转债公允价值、旧债结算、总奖励、融资租赁及期初税项／收购／资本请求权仍未解决。不假设当前报价、价格比较或回购执行。Visual Layer 于四月十四日宣布，五月十二日前已完成；不能确认四月交割。六月余额已反映收购，不重复扣款。

新模拟默认值为零宽度且未经校准。蒙特卡洛仅手动运行。命名情景没有指定概率。零宽度试验复现各选定经营情景，权益输出仍被限制。

2016–2025 财年历史保留逐字段来源及单位。2019–25 年稀释股数 XBRL 单位错误已修正；2025 年加权稀释股数为 49.97 百万股，与六月流通普通股不同。早期持续经营现金流与可能覆盖整体业务的资本开支范围不同；保留并提示已报告折旧差异。
